description:
Perform a bulk salary revision for all employees with the designation 'Junior Developer'.

1. Navigate to the Salary Increment or Salary Revision module.
2. Filter or select ONLY the employees with the designation 'Junior Developer'.
3. Update their Basic Salary to 3500.00.
4. Set the Effective Date for this change to 01-Apr-2025.
5. Save the revision.

Currently, there are 3 Junior Developers (Dev One, Dev Two, Dev Three) with a Basic Salary of 3000.00. Do not modify the salary of any other employees.
